en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a small European town in a hilly, rural landscape. In the middle ground are compact, gabled houses and larger masonry buildings along a narrow street, with trees and gardens around them. A church with a tall spire rises in the left background. The foreground is an open, grassy or crop-covered slope. The lower part of the card is left blank for writing, with the printed caption "Stadt Bärenstein." in red at the bottom center.
